contract.interface:
For odd prime p and W<=F_p^N, legal directions D(W,x)=(W intersect product_i{0,+x_i,-x_i}) minus {0}, x in (F_p^*)^N, generate support cone C(W,x). Hypothesis CB requires ONE fixed r in R_{>0}^N belonging to every C(W,x): sum_w lambda_{x,w} 1_{w_i!=0}=r_i with lambda>=0. Unequal coordinate clocks are allowed; state dependence is not. Under CB the note proves log|F_p^N/W|<=N(log3+(4/3)log2), hence p^{codim W}<=K0^N<8^N, K0=3*2^{4/3}. This is conditional existence, not an unconditional cover theorem or efficient algorithm.

At z use x_i=z_i if nonzero else1, with joint moves z+/-w at rate lambda/2. The generator preserves cosets and satisfies Q(f o pr_i)=r_i Lf o pr_i, where L resets nonzero b to0 or doubles it equally, and sends0 to+/-1 equally. Each marginal has stationary law pi: mass1/3 at0, otherwise S2^T mod p with uniform sign and Pr(T=t)=2^{-t-1}. Modular collisions only reduce entropy. Choose a stationary law in each coset; exact generator projection makes every marginal pi without coordinate independence or joint irreducibility. Uniform coset label is determined by Z, so quotient entropy<=sum H(Z_i)<=N H(pi). No mixing time or efficient representative sampler is supplied. A conic representation may use N directions, but finding all legal directions/scalings can cost exponentially.

The F5 subspace W={(a,b,c,-a+b+2c,3a+b)} is versatile yet fails unit balance. At all-ones scaling its nonzero supports are 01011,01111,11001, with exact separator (-1,1,0,-1,0). At x'=(2,2,2,2,1) every cone vector has r1=r5; all-twos scaling has r1+r4=r2=r5, forcing r4=0 in their intersection. Two explicit states have the same A-image and those cone types, defeating even coset-specific fixed positive clocks for this subspace. Binary-tree gluing preserves versatility but forces root clock=sum of L leaf clocks, distortion>=L, N=4L-3. Conversely unit balance is constructively preserved under coordinate gluing.

These counterexamples are NOT irredundant affine covers. The five rank-two normals cannot cover F5^2 with five lines unless parallel. The OPEN gate asks whether every genuine irredundant affine cover with normal-column matrix A has 1_N in C(ker A,x) at every nonzero scaling, or at least sufficient common positive clocks. A valid falsifier must include p,A, affine offsets, full coverage, a private point per hyperplane, scaling x and an exact separator against all legal supports. Bare versatility is insufficient. If a sufficient gate holds, the exponential cover target and cited finite-abelian reduction follow; a separate conditional matrix-avoidance statement uses p>K0^{km}. No circuit-lower-bound, singularity-resolution or technological consequence follows here.

Reset-and-double dynamics already appear in Nagy-Pach-Tomon's WITHDRAWN 2022 preprint, whose invalid theorem is not used. The proposed repair is exact marginal-generator lifting with a separately unproved feasibility condition. The 2021 proofs and 2026 abstract/publication were inspected by the producer; the full 2026 PDF was not retrieved. N735 supplies a source-reported transferable generator-projection idea only: CRN rate-query, exact-variate and compiler bounds do not transfer. Source finite F5 evidence is compatible with the gate but proves no asymptotic improvement. Historical priority, independent correctness and a new foundational primitive remain UNKNOWN.
